## Install

1. Download **{{DMG_NAME}}**, open it, and drag **Clatch** to **Applications**.
2. Open **Clatch** from Applications. It appears in the menu bar (no Dock icon).
3. Click the menu bar icon › **Add Another Account…** to set up your second Claude account.

Universal build (**Apple silicon + Intel**), macOS 11 Big Sur or later. Liquid Glass on macOS 26 and later.
